subject: Transportation Systems
title: Escalators and Elevators
description: A quick, practical guide to Escalators and Elevators.

hook.text: Some metro stations sit 200 feet underground. Getting passengers down there fast is a real challenge.

buildup.text: Long escalators carry thousands of riders per hour. Moscow's deepest station needs a three-minute ride.

discovery.text: Escalator reliability is critical. When one breaks, crowds bottleneck inside minutes.

twist.text: London's Tube has over 400 escalators. Keeping them all running requires a dedicated army of mechanics.

climax.text: Elevators are essential for accessibility but move far fewer people. Stations need both.

punchline.text: The escalator is the unsung hero of deep stations.

quiz.question: Why are escalators so important in deep metro stations?
options: They move thousands of passengers per hour vertically
